note: Event chains of the knowledge group, as data: for a main quantity (a family of measure-families.json) the ordered list of other quantities that follow it on a long story page, each a Eurostat table with its default slice, a semantic tag and the place it takes in the chain (English). Read by next_companion.rs (chain_companions) only; the main table's own companions (same topic, D8) are not here. A link stays on a page only when its fetched rows share places and years with the main table's; the order is the chain's order, so the first links that pass are the ones kept. slice = the dimension codes the sample fetches (works/sample-1122/data/chain/fetch.sh for the energy chain); time and geo come from the page.

links.position: Where the gas the grid leans on comes from: natural gas imports, so the share of renewables is read against the fuel it replaces.
What a household pays for electricity once gas and renewables meet in the grid: the price of a typical annual consumption band, taxes included.
The capacity that carries the shift: installed solar photovoltaic and wind power.
What the grid actually generated, by fuel: where the installed capacity turns into electricity.
The end of the chain: greenhouse gas emissions of public electricity and heat production.
The other side of the same labour force: the employment rate of people aged 20-64.
What moves jobs: real GDP growth on the previous year.
Where it lands in households: the share of people at risk of poverty or social exclusion.
